finding.summary: The cached battery power_supply reference acquired by power_supply_get_by_name() was never released.
evidence: Both recovered charger paths cache power_supply_get_by_name("battery") in syna_get_charger_status_batt_psy and reuse it for property reads.
The Android Common 6.12 power_supply_core.c API documentation says get_by_name increments the device reference and callers should call power_supply_put().
The driver had no power_supply_put call before this change.

order: unregister notifier and wait for callbacks
change.safety_condition: power_supply_put() runs only after the notifier is unregistered and both queued work paths are drained, so the cached pointer has no remaining reader.

sections: power_supply_get_by_name documents its held device reference and required put (lines 364-385).
power_supply_put drops the use count and device reference (lines 387-400).

limits: Canonical build and reproducibility passed; device runtime and NX809J hardware testing were not performed.
The power_supply pointer is module-global, consistent with this driver’s singleton global state.
